text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the cafeteria, two 
familiar faces were deep in conversation.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! Hey, Taishiiin! All you've been 
doing this whole time is playing that 
game!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Is it really that fun?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's a completely stupid 
puzzle.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Then why are you playing it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's boring, not being able to 
clear it pisses me off. It feels like the 
dev is mocking me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's do our best together! 
If the two of us try our hardest, I know 
we can beat it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? I really don't need that kind of――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do this, do this, do 
thiiis! Where do I touch and what do I do? 
Tell me!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... She's so relentless once she 
gets like this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: First, download the app on your phone――

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
――and that's how the controls work. Got 
it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I seeeee! This might actually be pretty 
tough?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But we're gonna clear it! Hyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, game over already?! Why, whyyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that stage is literal hell 
difficulty. Even I haven't cleared it yet.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Really?! But I'm sure I can do it!! 
Toryaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I told you you're too loud... Jeez, 
there's no way you can clear it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnnnngh!! I did itttt!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-How...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I don't even know myself! The secret 
is... "a never-give-up spirit", maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. I'm going next. Something like 
this, I just do this here and... bam!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them noisily pushed 
forward through the game—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Cleared it... All stages complete...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! We did it, Taishin! It's a 
victory we seized together as twooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, you're way too loud! Besides, 
it's not like we did it "together."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But I'm just so happyyy! Hehehe, a win 
together with Taishin~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Man, you really are simple-minded.
